instruction: Wash your hands, then put on clean gloves. Look at the cut on the skin pad. Check that it is not red, swollen or leaking. Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut on the skin pad. Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag and seal it. Then take off the gloves and wash your hands.

postconditions.condition: Gloves are worn on the hands.

actions.instruction: Look at the cut on the skin pad and check that it is not red, swollen or leaking.
actions.original_text: Look at the cut on the skin pad. Check that it is not red, swollen or leaking.

actions.instruction: Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut on the skin pad.
actions.original_text: Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut on the skin pad.

postconditions.condition: A pad covers the whole cut on the skin pad.
postconditions.source_reference: Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut on the skin pad.

actions.instruction: Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag.
actions.original_text: Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag

postconditions.condition: The pad wrapper is contained inside the zip bag.
postconditions.source_reference: Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag

postconditions.condition: The zip bag is visibly closed.
The gloves are no longer worn on the hands.

review_notes: Ensured all step dependencies are empty arrays.
Maintained exact source constraints.
Updated A3 to include the full target and check description as requested.
A1: The action of washing hands does not have a reliable, direct visual end state verifiable by a single image.
Action A1 requires manual completion due to the nature of the task.
A2: Omitted the adjective clean as per instructions.
A3: Clinical inspection of wound characteristics such as redness, swelling, or leakage is not amenable to objective computer vision verification and requires manual inspection.
A3 inspection criteria (red, swollen, leaking) are clinical/subjective assessments and are excluded from automated visual checks.
A4: Retained explicit constraint: WHOLE coverage.
A4: Omitted non-stick property as per instructions.
No global or procedure-level error criteria required for this request.
A5: Visual containment of the wrapper inside the zip bag is checked. The act of placing is omitted.
A5 is an atomic containment check.
A6: A6 verifies visual closure of the bag only; no airtight or adhesion claim.
A7: Removed the requirement to 'take off' which is an operation; checked instead for the visible state of absence from the hands.
A7 represents the visible end state of glove removal.
A8: Washing hands is a process-based activity without a reliable, persistent image-visible postcondition; manual completion required.
A1 and A8 require manual completion as there is no independent image end state for hand washing.
A3 requires manual completion as red, swollen, and leaking clinical inspections are not automatically verifiable via RGB image.
A2 postcondition is 'Gloves are worn on the hands.' Omitted 'clean'.
A4 postcondition is 'A pad covers the whole cut on the skin pad.' Omitted 'non-stick'.
A5 postcondition is 'The pad wrapper is contained inside the zip bag.'
A6 postcondition is 'The zip bag is visibly closed.' Omitted 'seal'.
A7 postcondition is 'The gloves are no longer worn on the hands.' Omitted 'take off'.
Global error criteria are not applicable; procedural checks rely on per-step verified states.

Prototype image-only rubric: actual Gemini outputs reviewed for source grounding and single-image scope, not a validated clinical protocol. Excluded instruction aspects are not automatically verified.
